result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on theta-function quotients (square roots of products of variables expressed as fourth roots of products of differences of parameters times theta quotients) for a system of linear relations among six variables, together with parameter relations involving λ.
result.transcription:
$f^2 = xyzt$
$\sqrt{\frac{\xi}{y}\frac{z_1}{y_1}} = \sqrt[4]{\Pi(\ldots)_{x=0}\,\Pi\frac{z}{y}{}_{t=0}}\;\frac{\vartheta}{\vartheta}$
$\sqrt{x\xi} + \sqrt{y\eta} + \sqrt{z\zeta} = 0$ \quad $\sqrt{x} = \frac{111}{111}$ \quad $\sqrt{\xi} = \frac{100}{100}$
$x + y + z + \xi + \eta + \zeta = 0$ \quad $\sqrt{x+y+z} = \frac{110}{100}$
$\alpha x + \beta y + \gamma z + \frac{\xi}{\alpha} + \frac{\eta}{\beta} + \frac{\zeta}{\gamma} = 0$
$\alpha' x + \beta' y + \gamma' z + \frac{\xi}{\alpha'} + \frac{\eta}{\beta'} + \frac{\zeta}{\gamma'} = 0$
$\alpha'' x + \beta'' y + \gamma'' z + \frac{\xi}{\alpha''} + \frac{\eta}{\beta''} + \frac{\zeta}{\gamma''} = 0$
[-$\frac{(\ldots)}{(\ldots)} = \sqrt[4]{\frac{(\alpha\beta\gamma)(\frac{1}{\alpha}\frac{1}{\beta}\gamma)(\frac{1}{\alpha}\beta\gamma)\frac{1}{\alpha}\beta\frac{1}{\gamma}}{(\frac{1}{\alpha}\frac{1}{\beta}\frac{1}{\gamma})(\alpha\beta\frac{1}{\gamma})(\alpha\frac{1}{\beta}\frac{1}{\gamma})(\alpha\frac{1}{\beta}\gamma)}}$-]
$\sqrt{\frac{\xi}{x}\frac{\xi_1}{x_1}} = \sqrt[4]{\frac{(\alpha\beta\gamma)(\alpha\frac{1}{\beta}\gamma)(\alpha\beta\frac{1}{\gamma})(\alpha\frac{1}{\beta}\frac{1}{\gamma})}{(\frac{1}{\alpha}\beta\gamma)(\frac{1}{\alpha}\frac{1}{\beta}\gamma)(\frac{1}{\alpha}\beta\frac{1}{\gamma})(\frac{1}{\alpha}\frac{1}{\beta}\frac{1}{\gamma})}}\;\frac{\vartheta}{\vartheta}$ , $(\alpha\beta\gamma) = \alpha\beta' - \alpha'\beta + \alpha'\gamma - \alpha\gamma' + \beta\gamma' - \beta'\gamma$ \quad $\sqrt{\frac{\xi}{x}\frac{\xi_1}{x_1}} = \sqrt{\alpha\alpha'\alpha''}\;\frac{\vartheta}{\vartheta}$
$\frac{\beta\beta'\beta''}{\gamma\gamma'\gamma''} = \frac{(\alpha\beta\frac{1}{\gamma})(\frac{1}{\alpha}\beta\frac{1}{\gamma})}{(\frac{1}{\alpha}\frac{1}{\beta}\gamma)(\alpha\frac{1}{\beta}\gamma)}$ \quad $\frac{(\alpha\beta\gamma)(\alpha\frac{1}{\beta}\gamma)}{(\frac{1}{\alpha}\frac{1}{\beta}\frac{1}{\gamma})(\frac{1}{\alpha}\beta\frac{1}{\gamma})} = \alpha\alpha'\alpha''\gamma\gamma'\gamma''$ \quad $\frac{(\alpha\beta\frac{1}{\gamma})(\alpha\frac{1}{\beta}\gamma)}{(\frac{1}{\alpha}\beta\gamma)(\frac{1}{\alpha}\frac{1}{\beta}\gamma)} = \frac{\alpha\alpha'\alpha''}{\gamma\gamma'\gamma''}$
$(1+\alpha\lambda+\alpha'\lambda')(1+\frac{\lambda}{\alpha}+\frac{\lambda'}{\alpha'}) = (1+\beta\lambda+\beta'\lambda')(1+\frac{\lambda}{\beta}+\frac{\lambda'}{\beta'}) = (1+\gamma\lambda+\gamma'\lambda')(1+\frac{\lambda}{\gamma}+\frac{\lambda'}{\gamma'})$
$\lambda\lambda'(\frac{\alpha'}{\alpha}+\frac{\alpha}{\alpha'}) + \lambda(\alpha+\frac{1}{\alpha}) + \lambda'(\alpha'+\frac{1}{\alpha'}) = \lambda\lambda'(\frac{\beta'}{\beta}+\frac{\beta}{\beta'}) + \lambda(\beta+\frac{1}{\beta}) + \lambda'(\beta'+\frac{1}{\beta'}) = \lambda\lambda'(\frac{\gamma'}{\gamma}+\frac{\gamma}{\gamma'}) + \lambda(\gamma+\frac{1}{\gamma}) + \lambda'(\gamma'+\frac{1}{\gamma'}) = \lambda_1^2 - 1 - \lambda^2 - \lambda'^2$
$\alpha' + \frac{1}{\alpha'} - \beta' - \frac{1}{\beta'} = (\alpha'-\beta')(1-\frac{1}{\alpha'\beta'})$
[-$\lambda(\alpha-\frac{1}{\alpha}) + \lambda'(\frac{\alpha}{\alpha'}\ldots)$-]
$\frac{\alpha'-\beta'\,(1-\frac{1}{\alpha'\beta'})}{\alpha-\beta\,(1-\frac{1}{\alpha\beta})} = \frac{(\alpha'-\gamma')(1-\frac{1}{\alpha'\gamma'})}{(\alpha-\gamma)(1-\frac{1}{\alpha\gamma})}$
$\xi = (a-1)x$ \quad $\eta = (b-1)y$ \quad $\zeta = (c-1)z$
$ax + by + cz = 0$
$\frac{\alpha-\frac{1}{\alpha}}{a} + \frac{1}{\alpha} = \frac{\beta-\frac{1}{\beta}}{b} + \frac{1}{\beta} = \frac{\gamma-\frac{1}{\gamma}}{c} + \frac{1}{\gamma} = \lambda$ \quad $a = \frac{\alpha-\frac{1}{\alpha}}{\lambda-\frac{1}{\alpha}}$ \quad $b = \frac{\beta-\frac{1}{\beta}}{\lambda-\frac{1}{\beta}}$ \quad $c = \frac{\gamma-\frac{1}{\gamma}}{\lambda-\frac{1}{\gamma'}}$[?]
$\frac{\alpha'-\frac{1}{\alpha'}}{a} + \frac{1}{\alpha'} = \frac{\beta'-\frac{1}{\beta'}}{b} + \frac{1}{\beta'} = \frac{\gamma'-\frac{1}{\gamma'}}{c} + \frac{1}{\gamma'} = \lambda'$ \quad $\xi = \frac{\alpha-\lambda}{\lambda-\frac{1}{\alpha}}x$ \quad $\eta = \frac{\beta-\lambda}{\lambda-\frac{1}{\beta}}y$ \quad $\zeta = \frac{\gamma-\lambda}{\lambda-\frac{1}{\gamma}}z$
$(\alpha'-\frac{1}{\alpha'})\lambda - \lambda'(\alpha-\frac{1}{\alpha}) = \frac{\alpha'}{\alpha} - \frac{\alpha}{\alpha'}$ \quad $(\alpha'-\frac{1}{\alpha'})\lambda + (\frac{1}{\alpha}-\alpha)\lambda' + (\frac{\alpha}{\alpha'}-\frac{\alpha'}{\alpha}) = 0$
$(\beta'-\frac{1}{\beta'})\lambda - \lambda'(\beta-\frac{1}{\beta}) = \frac{\beta'}{\beta} - \frac{\beta}{\beta'}$
$(\gamma'-\frac{1}{\gamma'})\lambda - \lambda'(\gamma-\frac{1}{\gamma}) = \frac{\gamma'}{\gamma} - \frac{\gamma}{\gamma'}$ \quad $\lambda(\xi+\eta+\zeta) - (\frac{1}{\alpha}\xi + \frac{1}{\beta}\eta + \frac{1}{\gamma}\zeta) = (\alpha x+\beta y+\gamma z) - \lambda(x+y+z)$

methods.what: Linear system of relations among six variables with parameters α, β, γ and reciprocals
Theta quotient expressed as fourth root of product of determinant-like parameter brackets
Definition of bracket as alternating sum (2x2 minors)
Relations between products of parameters and bracket quotients
Equality of quadratic forms in λ, λ' for three parameter sets
Parametrization of ξ,η,ζ in terms of x,y,z via λ
